children: of the NASA‑IBM Lunar Foundation Model, an AI model designed to help scientists analyze decades of lunar observation data.

The model was trained on a large dataset of lunar observations compiled by IBM and NASA researchers and is intended to help turn complex data from multiple instruments into insights supporting future scientific exploration and a sustained human presence on the Moon.

It is said to exceed widely used methods by up to 23% in identifying key geographic features on the Moon's surface, including potential ice deposits, craters, and volcanic formations, to support a sustained return to the Moon.

title: IBM, NASA release open-source AI model to support lunar exploration
